[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean
import Lean.Data.String.Basic

def implementation (string: String) (n: Nat) : Nat :=
let parts := string.splitOn " and " in
let apples_str := parts[0] in
let oranges_str := parts[1] in
let apples := apples_str.parseNat in
let oranges := oranges_str.parseNat in
n - apples - oranges
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma parseNat_non_neg (s: String) : 0 ≤ s.parseNat :=
by
rw [String.parseNat]
have h := String.to_nat_nonneg s;
simp [h]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string n
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
use apples, oranges
have h_parts := string.splitOn " and " parts
have h_apples := apples_str.parseNat apples
have h_oranges := oranges_str.parseNat oranges
have h_parts := string.splitOn " and " parts
have h_sum := h_parts.1 (apples + oranges) = n - result
have h_string := string.join [apples.repr, " apples and ", oranges.repr, " oranges"] = string
by
  simp [apples, oranges, h_apples, h_oranges]
  rw [h_parts.2]
  simp [h_sum]
  simp [h_string]
[END]
